faqHotes.intro: Everything you need to know to list your cabin on Kabanalouer
faqHotes.s1q1: How do I create my listing?
faqHotes.s1a1: Create a free owner account, fill in your cabin information (photos, description, amenities, calendar), then activate your listing via the "Publish my listing" section.
faqHotes.s1q2: How long does it take to create a listing?
faqHotes.s1a2: Between 15 and 30 minutes for a complete listing. Our AI can generate your title and description automatically.
faqHotes.s1q3: Do I need a CITQ number?
faqHotes.s1a3: Yes, a valid 6-digit CITQ number is required to publish your listing on Kabanalouer, in accordance with Quebec regulations.
faqHotes.s2q1: How many photos can I add?
faqHotes.s2a1: Up to 80 photos per listing. A minimum of 5 photos is required to publish. Photos are automatically compressed to WebP for optimal quality.
faqHotes.s2a2: Accepted formats: JPG, PNG, WebP. Maximum size: 2 MB per photo after automatic compression. Recommended resolution: minimum 1920 px.
faqHotes.s3q1: How do I manage my availability?
faqHotes.s3a1: In your dashboard, go to the Calendar section of your listing. You can block dates manually or sync automatically via iCal (Airbnb, Booking.com, etc.).
faqHotes.s3a2: Yes, automatic sync runs every hour. You can also force a manual sync at any time.
faqHotes.s4a1: Via Kabanalouer's built-in messaging. You receive an email notification for each new message.
faqHotes.s4a2: No. Travelers write to you through Kabanalouer's built-in messaging and you reply in the same place, or directly by email by replying to the notification you receive.
faqHotes.s5q1: What happens if I don't renew?
faqHotes.s5a1: Your listing is automatically unpublished at expiry, but your data stays intact — photos, description, reviews — for as long as you like. Nothing is deleted automatically.
faqHotes.s5a2: Yes. Each cabin has its own subscription, with volume pricing: the more cabins you list, the less each subscription costs.
faqHotes.s5q3: Does the free offer apply to all my cabins?
faqHotes.s5a3: Yes. Each cabin gets its own free first year, no matter how many cabins you list.
faqHotes.ctaSubtitle: Our team is available to help you.

commentCaMarche.intro: Contact owners directly and avoid unnecessary service fees.
commentCaMarche.step1Desc: Use our search engine to find the perfect cabin. Filter by region, number of travelers and amenities to make your search easier.
commentCaMarche.step2Desc: Send a message directly to the owner through our built-in messaging. Ask your questions and get a quote with no service fees.
commentCaMarche.step3Desc: Once your stay is booked with the owner, all that's left is to pack your bags and enjoy your getaway in the heart of Quebec!
commentCaMarche.why1Desc: Unlike major platforms, Kabanalouer charges no service fees to travelers. The listed price is the price you pay.
commentCaMarche.why2Desc: No middleman. You communicate directly with the owner to customize your stay.
commentCaMarche.why3Desc: All our owners are verified. Authentic cabins across Quebec, for every budget and every season.
commentCaMarche.faq1A: No. Kabanalouer is a connection platform (marketplace). Payment is made directly between you and the owner, according to the terms you agree on.
commentCaMarche.faq2Q: How do I contact an owner?
commentCaMarche.faq2A: Request a quote for the cabin you're interested in or click "Contact the owner" on the cabin listing. You need to create a free account to send a message.
commentCaMarche.faq3Q: Do I need to pay to create an account?
commentCaMarche.faq3A: No, creating a traveler account is completely free.
commentCaMarche.faq4Q: How do I know if a cabin is available?
commentCaMarche.faq4A: Each listing shows an availability calendar updated by the owner. You can also filter by dates in the search.
commentCaMarche.faq5Q: What if the owner doesn't respond?
commentCaMarche.faq5A: We recommend waiting 24–48 hours. If you haven't heard back, feel free to contact another similar cabin.
commentCaMarche.ctaSubtitle: Cabins all over Quebec, rented directly by the people who know them best: their owners.

aPropos.h1: We removed the middleman. The rest is between you and the owner.
aPropos.origin1: Kabanalouer was born from something many cabin owners in Quebec have noticed. The big platforms take a lot along the way: service fees added to travelers' bills, a commission withheld on every stay, and filtered exchanges that keep people from really talking before they reach an agreement. In the end, everyone pays more for a service whose main value is putting two people in touch.
aPropos.origin2: So we kept what works (a great showcase, clear listings, simple messaging) and removed the rest.
aPropos.modelTitle: A simple model, and we'll be upfront about it.
aPropos.model1: Owners pay a fixed annual subscription to list their cabin. That's it. We take no commission on stays, and travelers pay no fees. You find a cabin, you write freely to the owner, and you agree together on the dates and the price.
aPropos.model2: Since our revenue doesn't depend on the amount of your booking, we have no interest in pushing it up.

privacy.metaDesc: Privacy policy of Kabanalouer — how we collect, use, and protect your personal data in compliance with Quebec's Law 25.
privacy.label: Legal
privacy.intro: This privacy policy describes how Kabanalouer ("we", "our") collects, uses, and protects your personal data when you use the platform at kabanalouer.ca. It complies with the Act to modernize legislative provisions as regards the protection of personal information (Law 25, Quebec) and the Personal Information Protection and Electronic Documents Act (PIPEDA, Canada).
privacy.s1P1: The controller of your personal data is Kabanalouer, operating the platform at kabanalouer.ca.
privacy.s1P2: For any questions regarding the protection of your data, you may contact our Privacy Officer at:
privacy.s2Intro: We collect the following categories of data:
privacy.s2RegI3: Password (stored in hashed form, never in plain text)
privacy.s2ListI1: Cabin information (title, description, address, amenities, rates)
privacy.s2MsgI1: Content of messages exchanged between owners and travelers via the platform
privacy.s2PayI1: We do not store your payment data. Transactions are processed directly by Stripe. We only retain your Stripe subscription ID.
privacy.s3I1: Create and manage your user account.
privacy.s3I2: Display your listings to travelers on the platform.
privacy.s3I3: Enable communication between owners and travelers via the built-in messaging system.
privacy.s3I5: Send transactional notifications (new messages, subscription expiry, etc.).
privacy.s3I6: Improve the platform by analyzing browsing behavior (aggregated and anonymized data).
privacy.s3I7: Comply with our legal and regulatory obligations.
privacy.s3P2: We do not use your data for targeted advertising to third parties and never sell it.
privacy.s4P1: We engage trusted service providers to operate the platform. These third parties act as processors and may only use your data for the purposes for which we have engaged them.
privacy.s4D1: Database and authentication. Data stored on AWS servers (us-east-1 region). Policy: supabase.com/privacy
privacy.s4D2: Platform hosting and deployment. Access logs retained according to Vercel's policy. Policy: vercel.com/legal/privacy-policy
privacy.s4D3: Owner subscription payment processing. Stripe is PCI-DSS certified. Policy: stripe.com/privacy
privacy.s4D4: Web traffic analysis (aggregated and anonymized data). IP addresses are truncated. Policy: policies.google.com/privacy
privacy.s4D5: Automatic listing description generation (optional feature). Only listing content is transmitted, with no personally identifiable data. Policy: anthropic.com/privacy
privacy.s4P2: Beyond these service providers, we do not share your data with any third party, except as required by law (response to a competent authority, court order).
privacy.s5P1: In accordance with Quebec's Law 25, you have the following rights regarding your personal information:
privacy.s5D1: You may request to view the personal information we hold about you.
privacy.s5D2: You may request the correction of inaccurate, incomplete, or ambiguous information.
privacy.s5D3: You may request the deletion of your personal information, subject to our legal retention obligations.
privacy.s5D4: You may request to receive your personal information in a structured, commonly used technological format.
privacy.s5D5: In certain circumstances, you may request that a hyperlink providing access to your information be de-indexed.
privacy.s5D6: You may object to the use of your data for certain purposes, particularly for communication purposes.
privacy.s5P2: To exercise these rights, send your request to support@kabanalouer.ca. We will process your request within 30 days.
privacy.s6D1: Your data is retained for the lifetime of your account.
privacy.s6D2: Your listing data remains stored indefinitely after your subscription expires, so you can renew at any time. No automatic deletion is applied.
privacy.s6D3: Your personal data is deleted within 30 days of account deletion. Data required to meet our legal obligations (billing) may be retained longer.
privacy.s6D4: Messages are retained as long as both accounts involved exist. Deleting an account results in the anonymization of associated messages.
privacy.s6D5: Access logs are retained according to Vercel's policies (generally 30 days). Google Analytics data is aggregated and retained for 14 months.
privacy.s7Intro: We use the following types of cookies:
privacy.s7D1: Required for platform operation (authentication session, navigation preferences). Cannot be disabled.
privacy.s7D2: Google Analytics to understand platform usage. These cookies are anonymized and cannot identify you personally.
privacy.s7P2: You can manage your cookie preferences through your browser settings. Disabling essential cookies may affect platform functionality.
privacy.s8P1: We implement appropriate technical and organizational measures to protect your personal data against unauthorized access, disclosure, modification, or destruction:
privacy.s8I2: Passwords hashed with bcrypt (via Supabase Auth).
privacy.s8I3: Database access restricted by Row Level Security (RLS).
privacy.s8I4: Sensitive API keys stored as environment variables, never exposed client-side.
privacy.s8I5: Regular review of access and permissions within our team.
privacy.s8P2: In the event of a data breach likely to create serious risk to your rights, we will notify you within the timeframes required by law (72 hours for authorities, as soon as possible for affected individuals).
privacy.s9P1: We may update this privacy policy to reflect changes in our practices or to comply with legal requirements. For material changes, we will notify you by email or via a visible notice on the platform at least 15 days before the changes take effect. The date of the last update is shown at the top of this page.
privacy.s10P1: For any questions, requests to exercise your rights, or complaints about the processing of your personal data, contact us at:
privacy.s10P2: If you believe your rights are not being respected, you may also file a complaint with the Commission d'accès à l'information du Québec (CAI).
